appearance.identity: Bulging blue-glass threefold cocoon wrapped by white meridians and crossing web.
appearance.exclusions: Separate egg-shaped hall, internal school floors, exact curtain-wall fabrication.

brief: Budgeted Cocoon Tower exterior: curved threefold glass skin, sharper pictured crown, three atrium seams and wrapping white web. Detailed source master independently preserved.

sourceFacts.facade: Three linked towers enclosed by a rounded cocoon; three-story school groups
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original173844-triangle16412772-byte source reproduced exactly. Independent compact source preserves envelope controls with simplified glazing/web density and a picture-led crown correction.
